content.short: Moar Market is a modular lending protocol on Aptos featuring isolated pools and composable leverage.
content.description:
Moar Market is an innovative, non-custodial decentralized lending protocol built natively on the Aptos blockchain. Designed for maximum capital efficiency, the platform utilizes a modular architecture that features isolated lending pools, allowing for precise risk management and specialized rates for niche assets. Users can leverage "Credit Accounts"—user-owned smart accounts that enable composable leverage by allowing borrowed funds to be deployed directly into other whitelisted Aptos DeFi protocols while remaining within the secure account framework.

By leveraging the high throughput and security of the Move programming language, Moar Market delivers a professional-grade borrowing and lending experience with sub-second finality. The protocol supports up to 10x leverage on select strategies, providing sophisticated traders with the tools needed to amplify their yields. As a core component of the Aptos liquidity layer, Moar Market focuses on fostering deep integration and transparency, empowering users to build and manage complex decentralized portfolios with institutional-grade precision.
